title: Aamir Ibrahim Stresses Citizen-in-the-Loop for Sovereign AI
excerpt: JazzWorld's Aamir Ibrahim highlights the need for a citizen-in-the-loop approach to build sovereign artificial intelligence.
body_html:
Aamir Ibrahim of JazzWorld has emphasized the importance of a citizen-in-the-loop approach for achieving sovereign artificial intelligence. According to Ibrahim, nations need to make sure that citizens actively participate in the development and creation of AI systems, moving beyond the role of mere consumers.

This perspective focuses on shaping local artificial intelligence frameworks that directly involve the population, ensuring that technological advancements align more closely with national and societal interests rather than relying entirely on outside models.
